  • Contribute to video content ideas for YouTube and X that resonate with developers and AI enthusiasts.
  • Build a strong connection with users through video — explain concepts in simple language, keep it engaging, and use humor, memes, and viral hooks. 
  • Work closely with the SMM and product teams on new features and product updates. 
  • Stay up to date with AI and tech trends.

• Basic video creation and editing skills (short-form content).
  • Understanding of viral content principles.
  • Experience with YouTube and X.
  • A portfolio of past work (video cases, presentations, blogs).
  • Comfort and enjoyment of public speaking and being on camera.
  • Experience using AI tools.
  • Strong interest in technology, AI, and startups.
  • Curiosity, openness, and willingness to experiment.
  • Fluent English (minimum B2 level, both written and spoken) for video creation.
  • Fluent Russian (minimum C1 level) for team communication.
  • Willingness to complete a test assignment.

• Experience running a video blog, especially in tech/AI, or education. 
  • Experience working with dev or AI communities.
  • Basic understanding of coding.
  • Experience with vibe coding and prompt engineering.

• External Vendor contract.
  • Flexible collaboration format - part-time or full-time, depending on your experience and interests.
  • Competitive compensation in EUR or crypto.
  • Flexible working hours - create when you feel most productive and inspired.
  • Freedom to experiment with content formats, ideas, and creative approaches.
  • Opportunity to directly influence both the product and the AI/developer community through your content.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools and technologies.
  • A fast-growing AI startup environment where your ideas can quickly turn into real features and content.
  • Collaboration with a passionate team focused on AI, technology, and innovation.

  • Work with integrations — connecting external APIs, vector databases, knowledge sources

  • Analyze requirements and turn them into scalable components
  • Monitor skill performance and iterate based on feedback

  • Russian Native — for team communication

  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (AutoGPT, LangChain, LlamaIndex patterns)
  • Fine-tuning experience or working with models through different APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face)
  • Understanding of function calling and tool use in LLMs
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for assessing AI output quality
  • Work with semantic search, knowledge graphs

  • Access to modern AI tools and models (OpenAI API, Anthropic, etc.)
  • Opportunity to influence platform architecture
  • Mentorship and professional growth in a fast-evolving field
  • Professional, positive team

  • Experience with BI tools: dashboard development and ability to guide data analysts
  • English B2 or above: confident in business correspondence and documentation

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Backend: Node.js, Nest.js, Express, Golang
Frontend: React, Mobx, Redux
DB: PostgreSQL
CI/CD: gitlab, Docker, Kubernetes
